Hey friends, this video is about why we know exactly what to do and then still don't do it. I invited Nir Eyal over to Hong Kong to talk it through, because his new book Beyond Belief makes the case that what's really stopping us sits underneath our discipline and our motivation, in the beliefs we carry around without ever examining them. We get into the motivation triangle, the rats that swam for 60 hours, the actual formula for burnout, and the four questions Nir uses to swap out a belief that's causing him to suffer. He also does a live turnaround on one of my own limiting beliefs about making YouTube videos. Hope you enjoy xx

videos.title: Essentials: Genes & the Inheritance of Memories Across Generations | Dr. Oded Rechavi
videos.description:
See Andrew Huberman live in New York, Los Angeles & San Francisco:
https://go.hubermanlab.com/protocols-event

 In this Huberman Lab Essentials episode, my guest is Dr. Oded Rechavi, a professor at Tel Aviv University who studies genetics, epigenetics and the inheritance of acquired traits. We discuss how DNA, RNA and epigenetic mechanisms determine what information can pass between generations, and why acquired traits are generally not thought to be inherited. We also explain research in C. elegans showing how small RNAs can transmit antiviral resistance and influence behavior across generations, what these findings might mean for mammals and humans, and potential future applications for reproductive health and diagnostics.

Show notes: https://go.hubermanlab.com/HbTfdok

Full episode with Dr. Oded Rechavi: https://youtu.be/CDUetQMKM6g

Watch more Huberman Lab Essentials: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLPNW_gerXa4OGNy1yE-W9IX-tPu-tJa7S&si=a1_sA7rUT-fE0OM5
